findings.passage: I absolutely agree reforms are needed in order to more efficiently perform election tabulations. It is unacceptable that Arizonans wait for weeks to receive election results while other states, much larger than us, have their results posted the night of the election.
findings.note: His written answer to a Maricopa County Board of Supervisors appointment questionnaire. The question asked about reforms (such as ending election-day drop-off of early ballots) to speed up counting. The PDF has no date on its face; its file properties show it was made in mid-March 2026, before his 2026-03-17 appointment. He does not mention voter ID or citizenship proof.
